articles.title: Brian Hickerson's alleged threatening texts to Hayden Panettiere emerge after her death
articles.standfirst: Court documents reveal disturbing messages allegedly sent after his 2020 arrest as scrutiny returns to the couple's troubled history
articles.summary: Court documents reveal disturbing messages allegedly sent after his 2020 arrest as scrutiny returns to the couple's troubled history
articles.body:
Brian Hickerson's past relationship with Hayden Panettiere is facing renewed scrutiny after alleged threatening text messages he sent following a 2020 domestic violence arrest resurfaced in court records.

The messages were reportedly sent while Hickerson was subject to a no-contact order involving Panettiere , with prosecutors accusing him of attempting to pressure the actress as his criminal case unfolded.

One alleged message read: "Time to go to war I guess."

Other texts reportedly threatened to release damaging information unless Panettiere cooperated with him, adding another disturbing layer to a relationship that had already resulted in multiple arrests and allegations of abuse.

The documents have attracted fresh attention following Panettiere's death at 36 on August 16.

Hickerson allegedly pressured Panettiere after arrest

Hickerson was arrested in Wyoming in February 2020 following an alleged domestic violence incident involving Panettiere .

According to court documents, prosecutors later accused him of sending messages that violated restrictions on contacting her and amounted to witness intimidation.

The alleged communications included warnings about releasing personal material and damaging Panettiere's reputation if she didn't help make the case disappear.

Hickerson ultimately pleaded no contest in 2021 to two felony counts of injuring a spouse or girlfriend. He was sentenced to 45 days in jail, probation and domestic violence classes.

He later acknowledged his abusive behavior publicly, while Panettiere also discussed the relationship in detail before her death.

Old allegations resurface after Panettiere's death

The timing of the resurfaced messages is particularly sensitive because Hickerson had reportedly reconnected with Panettiere before she died.

The pair traveled to South Carolina together shortly before Panettiere was found unresponsive, while Hickerson and his brother were reportedly at the apartment complex when emergency services arrived.

Police have said their preliminary investigation found no signs of foul play or suspicious circumstances, and Hickerson hasn't been accused of causing Panettiere's death .

Her official cause of death remains under investigation .

Still, the newly highlighted messages provide another reminder of how volatile their relationship had once been.

Panettiere had previously spoken publicly about surviving domestic abuse and later said she believed in forgiveness and accountability after Hickerson sought treatment.

Whatever happened between them in the years that followed, the language contained in the alleged 2020 messages paints a troubling picture of one of the darkest periods in their relationship.

articles.title: Hayden Panettiere's life away from Hollywood: this was the place where she spent her final days
articles.standfirst: The actress lived in an apartment in West Hollywood, a far cry from the multimillion-dollar mansion she bought when she was just 18 years old.
articles.summary: The actress lived in an apartment in West Hollywood, a far cry from the multimillion-dollar mansion she bought when she was just 18 years old.
articles.body:
During her early years of fame, Hayden Panettiere owned a property that matched the stage her career was in. In 2008, when she was still one of the young stars of Heroes, she bought a mansion in Hollywood Hills for $2.63 million.

Several years later, Panettiere rented a two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment in a complex built during the 1980s, in West Hollywood . The unit was located in a tree-lined area, near the Sunset Strip.

An apartment far from the luxuries of a mansion

The place where she spent her last years in Los Angeles had a dining area and a loft-style living room. The rent was around $5,500 per month. It is a significant amount for a home in Los Angeles , although it was far from the value of that property that Panettiere had bought when she was at one of the best moments of her career.

The Hollywood Hills mansion was one of the actress's first major purchases. At the time, her role as Claire Bennet in Heroes had made her one of the most recognizable young faces on American television. Panettiere kept that property for several years and finally sold it in February 2014 for $3.075 million.

By the time she was living in the West Hollywood apartment, Hayden’s career had taken another direction. After Heroes , she landed another of her most important roles in Nashville, where she played Juliette Barnes between 2012 and 2018 and received two Golden Globe nominations. Over the years, however, her appearances on screen became less and less frequent.

Behind the success there were also difficult years. Hayden later spoke about his struggles with addiction, trauma, domestic violence, and the mental health difficulties he went through for much of his life.

The apartment where she spent the last days of her life was also the setting for a much more intimate life. Hayden shared that space with her pets, which appeared on several occasions on her social media. One of the images she posted in February 2024 showed her next to one of her dogs, which had just undergone surgery and was wearing an Elizabethan collar.

The West Hollywood apartment, however, was not the place where she died. Panettiere traveled from Los Angeles to Greenville, South Carolina , shortly before her death. There she was found unconscious in an apartment, and emergency services tried to revive her before declaring her dead at the age of 36. Authorities indicated that, in the initial investigation, they found no signs of violence or suspicious circumstances.

articles.title: Kendall Jenner surprises with her new skincare campaign: why did she choose this look?
articles.standfirst: The model surprised by becoming the first global ambassador for the Korean cosmetics brand ANUA.
articles.summary: The model surprised by becoming the first global ambassador for the Korean cosmetics brand ANUA.
articles.body:
K endall Jenner surprised everyone by becoming the first global ambassador for the Korean cosmetics brand Anua, posing with a minimalist and sporty look. The choice responds to a strategy to redefine skincare toward simplicity, embracing a natural aesthetic that reflects "glass skin" and the health of the skin barrier

The model was chosen as ANUA's first global ambassador and will lead a multi-year collaboration with the company.

Kendall Jenner and a very different campaign

The collaboration between the megastar and the skincare brand focuses on the era of minimalist skincare, betting on naturalness by doing away with heavy products to center on an athletic, fresh style that highlights the skin’s natural glow.

The photographs show Jenner in a sports context while promoting products intended for facial care. The contrast between the clothing and the type of product is precisely one of the aspects that most quickly captures attention.

The campaign is based on promoting a mist that combines different ideal elements for use during the day, with this product being one of the central pieces of the international strategy carried out by ANUA .

The look chosen by the model for the campaign

Jenner chose a white outfit that reveals a good part of her figure. The truth is that it seems more like a fashion campaign than a traditional ad for facial products.

Although the aesthetic moves away from the reality of advertising in that style, the choice gives the campaign a strong visual component that is both appealing and eye-catching.

The product Kendall was already using

According to Jenner herself, she had already tried ANUA products before becoming the international face of the brand.

Among the star's favorites are the green serum and a product with PDRN , an ingredient used in cosmetics and dermatology that is made up of fragments of purified DNA .

The partnership comes at a time of expansion for the Korean firm. ANUA entered the U.S. market in 2022 and, according to figures released by the company itself, the United States became its main market.

The model has built, over the last few years, an image linked to simple beauty routines and skincare. For ANUA, that connection was one of the reasons to choose her as its global face.

articles.title: Secret romance exposed: Hayden Panettiere was reportedly dating her boyfriend's brother
articles.standfirst: The previously undisclosed relationship sheds new light on the actress's tumultuous years with Brian Hickerson
articles.summary: The previously undisclosed relationship sheds new light on the actress's tumultuous years with Brian Hickerson
articles.body:
Hayden Panettiere's final years have brought renewed attention to the complicated relationships surrounding the actress, including a previously reported romance with Zach Hickerson , the older brother of her on-again, off-again boyfriend Brian Hickerson.

According to reports published after Panettiere's death, the actress was romantically linked to Zach in 2019, while Brian was incarcerated following an incident involving Panettiere . The reported relationship adds another unexpected chapter to a deeply turbulent period in her personal life.

Panettiere and Brian had begun dating in 2018, and their relationship was repeatedly interrupted by allegations of domestic violence, legal proceedings and periods of separation.

Despite those difficulties, the pair remained connected over the years and were reportedly together again shortly before Panettiere's death at 36.

The revelation about Zach comes as new details emerge about the circumstances surrounding Panettiere's death in South Carolina on August 16. A police report indicates that both Hickerson brothers were at the Judson Mill Lofts residence when emergency responders were called.

Brothers were reportedly present during her final moments

Reports say Zach discovered Panettiere unresponsive in a living-room chair while Brian was asleep in another room. Both brothers reportedly contacted emergency services, and medical personnel attempted to revive the actress before she was pronounced dead.

Authorities have said the preliminary examination found no signs of trauma, and no foul play has been suspected. The precise cause of death remains under investigation, while emergency dispatch audio reportedly referenced cardiac arrest and a possible overdose.

Zach , who has been described as a pastor, was approached by reporters outside his South Carolina home after the news emerged. He declined to discuss Panettiere , asking for privacy and saying he wouldn't answer questions about the situation.

The reported 2019 connection between Zach and Panettiere has attracted particular attention because it allegedly occurred during one of the actress's separations from Brian .

The pair were reportedly seen together in Manhattan's SoHo neighborhood that September, with an eyewitness describing them as appearing comfortable together.

Panettiere's death has also prompted renewed discussion of her struggles with addiction, mental health and family relationships. In her memoir, This Is Me: A Reckoning, released months before her death, she wrote candidly about difficult periods in her life and her relationship with Brian .

Her mother, Lesley Vogel , has since spoken publicly about her daughter's struggles and the family's grief, while Panettiere's former partner Wladimir Klitschko has also paid tribute.

The actress leaves behind her daughter, Kaya , and a body of work that includes Heroes, Nashville and the Scream franchise.

articles.title: The plans Hayden Panettiere had to celebrate her birthday with her 11-year-old daughter Kaya
articles.standfirst: The Heroes and Nashville star had been looking forward to a reunion with her daughter just days before her sudden death
articles.summary: The Heroes and Nashville star had been looking forward to a reunion with her daughter just days before her sudden death
articles.body:
H ayden Panettiere had been making plans for what should have been a deeply meaningful birthday week with her 11-year-old daughter, Kaya , before the actress died suddenly at the age of 36.

Panettiere was due to turn 37 on August 21, just five days after her death on August 16. According to a source close to the actress, she had been particularly excited about spending the week around her birthday with Kaya and had planned to travel to Germany to see her daughter.

“She was planning on spending the week of her birthday visiting her daughter in Germany,” the source told Page Six. “She was so excited to see her and was telling everyone how much she was looking forward to spending time with her.”

The plans now offer a particularly poignant insight into where Panettiere's priorities were in the final days of her life. Her daughter had remained a central part of her world despite the physical distance between them and the difficult circumstances surrounding their family history.

Panettiere shared Kaya with former professional boxer Wladimir Klitschko . The couple began their relationship in 2009, became engaged in 2013 and welcomed Kaya in 2014. Their relationship eventually ended in 2018, the same year Kaya began living primarily with her father in Europe.

Panettiere had previously spoken candidly about the emotional pain surrounding the custody arrangement. In 2022, she explained that giving Klitschko full custody while she worked on her health was among the most difficult experiences of her life.

More recently, she had pushed back against the idea that she had simply walked away from her daughter. In an interview earlier this year, Panettiere emphasized how much Kaya continued to mean to her and how painful the public perception of their situation had been.

Kaya remained at the center of Panettiere's life

The actress's hairstylist and close friend Erick Orellana also recalled how frequently Panettiere spoke about Kaya .

“I last saw her a few months ago,” Orellana said. “She was talking about how she wanted to take a vacation, and that she wanted to go and see her daughter. Her daughter was always her absolute priority. She loved her so much.”

Orellana , who worked with Panettiere for three years, said photographs and stories about Kaya were a regular part of their conversations.

“Her daughter was the absolute light of her life,” he told us. “She lit up when she spoke about her. Everything she did revolved around her.”

That description is consistent with comments Panettiere made publicly about their relationship. Despite living apart, she maintained contact with Kaya and continued to describe their connection as extremely important to her.

Panettiere's sudden death has therefore made the planned birthday visit particularly heartbreaking. Rather than marking her 37th birthday alongside her daughter, the family is now dealing with her loss.

Authorities in South Carolina have said there were no initial signs of foul play or suspicious circumstances, while the cause and manner of death remain under investigation. An autopsy reportedly found no signs of trauma.

Panettiere's father, Skip Panettiere , announced her death in a statement that remembered his daughter as “an incredible light and a force of nature who brought immeasurable love and joy to all who knew her, and to the millions who watched her onscreen.”

Panettiere is survived by Kaya and her parents. Her final birthday plans, which had been centered on spending precious time with her daughter, now form one of the most poignant details to emerge following her death.

articles.title: The unrecognizable Bill Clinton with long hair and an unkempt beard who reappeared for his 80th birthday
articles.standfirst: As part of the celebration of his 80th birthday, the former President of the United States surprised with a very different appearance from the one he usually shows in public.
articles.summary: As part of the celebration of his 80th birthday, the former President of the United States surprised with a very different appearance from the one he usually shows in public.
articles.body:
"T he former U.S. president once again became the center of attention, although this time it was not because of a political statement or a public appearance. A new photograph of the former president drew surprise for a much more unexpected detail: his appearance.

Clinton appears with hair considerably longer than usual and a thick beard that completely changes his image. The result is so different from the look the public is used to seeing him with that the first question arises almost automatically: What happened to him?

The image makeover that surprised everyone

For decades, Bill Clinton has maintained an easily recognizable image: short hair, a clean-shaven face or a very subtle beard, and the formal style associated with his political career. The new photograph completely breaks with that appearance. He wore a very different hairstyle when he studied at Yale Law School in the early 1970s and met the woman who would become his wife.

The photograph works like a small trip back in time to an era when Clinton was still far from becoming one of the most recognizable political figures in the United States. His young and relaxed appearance contrasts with the face that millions of people would eventually come to associate with the U.S. presidency.

The former president appears in the image with grown-out hair and a thick beard that covers much of his face. The contrast with his best-known photographs makes the transformation even more striking.

The change also brought back a curious detail from Clinton 's history: long hair is not entirely foreign to his past. Before becoming one of the best-known political figures in the United States, he had already worn a much less conventional look during his youth.

Precisely that contrast made the snapshot one of the most striking details of the celebration.

Along with the image, the former first lady shared an emotional message for Bill in the post, writing:

Happy birthday, dear Bill. Eighty years in to your extraordinary life, I feel very lucky to have spent over 50 of them with you. Here's to more dancing, talking, and laughing together in the years to come.

Bill and Hillary Clinton met in 1971 while studying at Yale Law School. The couple married in 1975 and, five years later, their only daughter, Chelsea, was born. By then, Bill had already begun building the political career that would ultimately take him to the White House .

articles.title: Jeff Bezos and Lauren Sanchez don't get special treatment in Miami: Their painfully slow process for exclusive membership
articles.standfirst: Being the founder of Amazon isn't enough credibility for one place in South Florida.
articles.summary: Being the founder of Amazon isn't enough credibility for one place in South Florida.
articles.body:
When you're the fourth-richest person in the world , you can practically live wherever you want. For Jeff Bezos , that has meant owning property in Seattle , Beverly Hills , Washington D.C ., New York City , West Texas , and even Maui .

But since 2023, Bezos and wife Lauren Sanchez have set up shop in Miami . More specifically, Bezos owns several properties on the exclusive Indian Creek Island , which is east of Miami Shores and north of Miami Beach . The man-made island has been dubbed " Billionaire Bunker " due to the incredible list of affluent people who own property there. Mark Zuckerberg recently purchased property there.

With the likes of Tom Brady , Ivanka Trump , and Jared Kushner serving as neighbors, Bezos should have no issues getting along with the community. But there's one aspect of the island that he and Sanchez are having trouble with: A membership at the Indian Creek Country Club .

Despite moving to Indian Creek Island in 2023, Jeff Bezos still hasn't been accepted into their country club

According to a report from the Wall Street Journal , Bezos and Sanchez are still in a holding pattern regarding their membership for the country club. Just because he's one of the richest people in the world doesn't mean Bezos is being allowed to skip the exclusive line . Per the report, those who are already members of the club aren't too fond of outside billionaires just coming in and joining .

The old guard — many of them retirees — are mounting a last stand against what they often view as billionaire interlopers... No one is going to make it easy because he is Jeff Bezos. articles.title: Hayden Panettiere's addictions during recent months come to light, involving 'whippets' and alcohol in hotels
articles.standfirst: The actress had been openly discussing recovery while disputed claims now shed light on a difficult period in Nashville
articles.summary: The actress had been openly discussing recovery while disputed claims now shed light on a difficult period in Nashville
articles.body:
Only three months before Hayden Panettiere ’s death, the actress was publicly talking about recovery and trying to rebuild her life. Behind the scenes, however, sources now claim she was still dealing with the addiction issues that had followed her for years.

During a May visit to Nashville to promote her memoir, This Is Me, Panettiere allegedly tried to have alcohol and nitrous oxide canisters delivered to her downtown hotel.

One source told Page Six that hotel security “stopped a [delivery service] order to her hotel room, which was several industrial grade nitrous oxide cans that she was planning on huffing.”

Another source made a similar allegation, saying, “She had alcohol and whippets delivered. They wouldn’t allow it up to her room.”

The account has been firmly disputed by Panettiere’s representative and friend Kasey Kitchen, who called the allegations “false.”

“She was in Nashville for a short amount of time and slept for most of it,” Kitchen said. “She also had private security with her.”

Panettiere was speaking openly about addiction

The reported Nashville incident came during a particularly vulnerable period in Panettiere’s life.

Days earlier, she appeared with Kitchen on The Tamron Hall Show and spoke candidly about how early her problems with substances began.

She recalled being given what she described as “happy pills” as a teenager before red carpet appearances and later discussed the frightening warning that eventually pushed her toward treatment.

“When I got to the point of looking in the mirror and seeing my eyes had turned yellow, and that I didn’t recognize my body anymore and I went into that doctor’s office and got a blood test, and he told me ‘If you don’t stop, you’re going to be looking at a liver transplant,’” Panettiere said.

“If I can’t do it for myself, I’m going to do it for my child,” she added.

Sources familiar with that period said Panettiere was focused on “resetting her life” and had grown especially close to Kitchen , whom she trusted beyond their professional relationship.

Death remains under investigation

Panettiere was found unresponsive in Greenville, South Carolina, on August 16 and was pronounced dead at 36.

Authorities haven't announced an official cause or manner of death. Dispatch audio reportedly referenced a possible overdose and CPR in progress, but that has not been confirmed as the cause.

An autopsy found no signs of trauma, while toxicology testing remains pending. The Drug Enforcement Administration has also reportedly joined the investigation.

The allegations surrounding the May hotel incident don't establish what caused Panettiere ’s death. They do, however, add another troubling layer to a story she had already told with unusual openness.

She spent years describing addiction not as something neatly left in the past, but as a battle that required constant work. Only months before her death, she was still trying to win it.

articles.title: “My person left long before”: Sandra Bullock speaks for the first time about what she experienced with Bryan Randall
articles.standfirst: The actress decided not to speak publicly about her partner's illness. She has now broken her silence, explaining why she chose to keep his illness private.
articles.summary: The actress decided not to speak publicly about her partner's illness. She has now broken her silence, explaining why she chose to keep his illness private.
articles.body:
S andra Bullock decided to share some details of those years and described the process she went through alongside the photographer, who died in August 2023.

Three years after the death of Bryan Randall , her partner for eight years, the Hollywood star shared how she privately faced the illness that ended the photographer’s life and how the grieving began long before his death.

A secret she kept for years

Bullock spoke about how difficult it was to keep silent. Randall had been diagnosed with ALS and, as Bullock explained, it was he himself who asked her to keep the illness private. She respected his decision, even though that meant spending a large part of the process away from public exposure and with very few people knowing the situation.

Randall asked Sandra not to let his illness become known, and she decided to respect his wish, even as the circumstances grew more complicated.

That meant that many people outside her closest circle were unaware of what the family was going through. The actress had to continue with her public life while, in private, the illness was taking up more and more space.

The pandemic made everything more difficult. The actress described a period marked by isolation and by the need to organize family life around Randall's needs.

“I started crying for Bryan four years earlier”

Bullock explained that she began saying goodbye to Randall years before he died. The illness had progressed to the point of profoundly altering his daily life and the relationship they had built together.

“My person was gone long before his body left,” said the actress. The phrase sums up how she experienced Randall’s decline: although he was still by her side, Bullock felt that the illness had gradually taken away the person she knew.

That is why, when his death finally came, the pain had several years of anticipation behind it. Bullock had already gone through part of the grieving process while she was still trying to be there for him.

Bryan Randall died at 57 after a three-year battle with ALS. His family had asked for privacy, and Bullock upheld that decision throughout that time.

His recent testimony now sheds light on a part of that story that remained out of the spotlight. More than speaking only about the death of Randall, Bullock recounted what it was like to lose him little by little while he was still by her side. A farewell that, for her, began years before that day in August 2023.

Now she enjoys her days with family, friends, and work while leaving her mark on social media.

articles.title: Kendall Jenner and Jacob Elordi reappear together in London. The family detail drew attention
articles.standfirst: The model and the actor shared an event again and left a sign that sparked special interest.
articles.summary: The model and the actor shared an event again and left a sign that sparked special interest.
articles.body:
K endall Jenner and Jacob Elordi were seen together again, this time during a meal in London. The meeting had a detail that quickly caught attention: the actor’s father was also present during the meal they shared at Cipriani.

The member of the Kardashian-Jenner clan and the star of Euphoria have chosen to keep their relationship away from major events and public statements. However, their appearances have become increasingly frequent.

Jenner arrived at the exclusive restaurant Cipriani with a simple yet very polished look. She wore a blue shirt over a white tank top, tailored trousers, sunglasses, and a Chanel bag.

" Elordi chose a more casual style, with a bomber jacket, dark pants, and his signature long hair accompanied by a sensual mustache.

The difference between both looks not only did not prevent them from once again projecting that image of a couple that has marked their latest appearances, but also makes them even more unique.

The couple share a distinctive attitude: simple garments, relaxed silhouettes, and luxury pieces that don’t need giant logos to show how much they cost.

The strategy fits especially well with Jenner 's wardrobe, increasingly associated with that quiet luxury that favors impeccable basics and accessories from labels such as The Row, Chanel or Hermès . Instead of turning every appearance into a runway, the model seems to have understood that, at this point, the real impact lies in looking as though she isn't trying too hard.

London seems to be adding a new chapter to that story. And perhaps the most revealing image is not that of two celebrities walking together, but that of two people who seem to have found a common aesthetic code without needing to explain it. Kendall brings sophisticated minimalism; Jacob , carefully imperfect dishevelment.

But the relationship seems to go far beyond fashion. The presence of Jacob 's father during dinner adds a significant detail and could be a sign that the bond between them is becoming increasingly serious.

articles.title: Brian Hickerson makes long-awaited response following tragic death of Hayden Panettiere
articles.standfirst: The actress’s on-again, off-again boyfriend spoke through his lawyer amid ongoing investigation
articles.summary: The actress’s on-again, off-again boyfriend spoke through his lawyer amid ongoing investigation
articles.body:
The first public response from Brian Hickerson since Hayden Panettiere ’s death has been notable less for what it says than for what it avoids.

With investigators still trying to determine what happened inside the Greenville, South Carolina, residence where Panettiere was found unresponsive Sunday, Hickerson has chosen to speak only through his attorney, Sloan Ellis .

“Hayden’s death remains under investigation and it is important to allow that investigation to proceed,” Ellis told TMZ.

“As has been publicly reported, police confirmed there were no signs of foul play,” the statement continued. “Out of respect for Hayden’s loved ones and the ongoing investigation, there will be no further comment at this time.”

That restraint comes as authorities continue examining the actress’s final hours. A cause and manner of death have not been announced.

What investigators know so far

Hickerson and his brother, Zach Hickerson , were both at the residence when Panettiere died, according to the reports.

Zach reportedly found her unresponsive in an armchair while Brian was asleep in another room. Emergency crews attempted resuscitation before she was pronounced dead at the scene.

Dispatch audio referenced an “unidentified female” in cardiac arrest and a possible overdose, but that hasn't been established as Panettiere ’s official cause of death.

Police also said Brian Hickerson showed officers a bag containing medications she had been taking.

An autopsy found no signs of trauma that contributed to her death, while toxicology testing and other investigative work remain pending. The Drug Enforcement Administration has also reportedly become involved in the broader investigation.

Hickerson’s history with Panettiere

Panettiere and Hickerson had been involved on and off since 2018, and their relationship was marked by serious legal problems.

In 2021, Hickerson pleaded no contest to two felony counts of injuring a spouse or girlfriend. He was sentenced to jail, probation and domestic violence classes, while other counts were dismissed.

Days before Panettiere ’s death, a judge reportedly denied Hickerson ’s attempt to have those convictions reduced or expunged.

Despite that history, the two remained connected. In May, Hickerson referred to Panettiere as his “good buddy” and said he hoped they might marry one day.

Panettiere is survived by her daughter Kaya , whom she shared with former heavyweight boxing champion Wladimir Klitschko .

Following her death, Klitschko said his family was experiencing “profound shock and grief.”

“She left this world far too soon,” he wrote. “Hayden was, although no longer my partner, an important part of my life and the mother of our daughter.”

Until investigators determine what caused Panettiere ’s death, Hickerson ’s first statement suggests he intends to remain publicly silent.

articles.title: Hayden Panettiere's mother shocks everyone blaming “toxic person” for daughter's death
articles.standfirst: Lesley Vogel addresses estrangement while investigation into the actress’s death continues
articles.summary: Lesley Vogel addresses estrangement while investigation into the actress’s death continues
articles.body:
The public fallout surrounding Hayden Panettiere ’s death has taken another turn after her mother, Lesley Vogel , issued a new statement defending her relationship with the actress and again pointing to what she described as a damaging influence in her daughter’s life.

Vogel , 70, spoke out Thursday after her initial comments about Panettiere’s death drew criticism from figures including Gayle King and Holly Robinson Peete .

This time, she focused more directly on the estrangement between mother and daughter and insisted the distance between them did not reflect a lack of affection.

“Although my daughter and I were estranged, it was not for lack of care or love,” Vogel told Entertainment Tonight. “It was due to the involvement of a toxic individual who I believe led to her death.”

She didn't identify that person in the new statement. Authorities haven't established that anyone caused Panettiere ’s death, and police have said there were no signs of foul play. The official cause remains under investigation.

Vogel says family tried to intervene

The remarks follow an earlier interview in which Vogel specifically named Brian Hickerson , Panettiere ’s on-again, off-again boyfriend, while discussing concerns the family had about her life.

“This person in her life that we have been trying to get rid of for quite some time was with her at her death,” Vogel previously said. “And that was Brian Hickerson.”

Hickerson was reportedly at the Greenville, South Carolina, apartment where Panettiere , 36, was found unresponsive on Sunday. His brother, Zach Hickerson , was reported to have discovered her while Brian was sleeping in another room.

The actress and Hickerson had been linked since 2018, and their relationship had previously involved domestic violence cases. Vogel said the family had tried unsuccessfully to pull Panettiere away from what she considered a harmful situation.

“Hayden was a beautiful and talented young woman who unfortunately became involved with the wrong person, and although her family tried to extricate him from her life, we were unable to be successful,” she said.

Backlash prompts more personal message

Vogel ’s original remarks prompted a sharp response from King , who discussed them on CBS Mornings.

“You know guys, you read this and all I can think is ‘Thanks mom, for nothing,’” King said.

Robinson Peete also criticized the tone of the statement and questioned whether Vogel had sufficiently acknowledged her own relationship with her daughter.

The follow-up statement appeared designed, at least in part, to address that criticism.

“I hope all remember Hayden for the beautiful human being inside her and her gift to the world from her time on this earth,” Vogel said. “My heart is with you, Hayden. Mama.”

An autopsy has been completed and toxicology testing remains pending. Vogel also pointed to the involvement of a narcotics investigator as evidence, in her view, that important questions remain.

“It leads me to believe there are still questions surrounding what happened,” she said. “And I think we are all looking for answers.”

Until investigators release their findings, however, any claim about another person contributing to Panettiere ’s death remains unproven.

articles.title: Legal experts explain whether Hayden Panettiere's death could lead to criminal charges
articles.standfirst: Could someone be held responsible for Panettiere’s death? Here’s what legal experts say investigators will be looking for
articles.summary: Could someone be held responsible for Panettiere’s death? Here’s what legal experts say investigators will be looking for
articles.body:
Hayden Panettiere’s sudden death has triggered a broader investigation, with the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) joining local authorities in examining what happened.

The 36-year-old actress was found unresponsive at a residence in Greenville, South Carolina, on Aug. 16. Emergency responders reportedly attempted to revive her, while dispatch audio referenced a possible overdose and cardiac arrest.

An official cause of death hasn’t yet been released, and authorities have said there were no initial signs of foul play.

The DEA’s involvement doesn’t necessarily mean criminal charges are imminent. Nathan Williams, a federal and state criminal defense attorney, said federal and local agencies frequently investigate suspected overdose deaths together before deciding whether prosecution is appropriate.

Attorney James Griffin , who isn’t involved in the case, believes the DEA’s participation could indicate investigators are looking into whether fentanyl was involved.

“In my view, the DEA has joined the investigation because Hayden’s death is possibly fentanyl related,” Griffin told People.

“There are significantly greater penalties under federal law for fentanyl-related death cases, and fentanyl drug cases are a federal law enforcement priority in South Carolina and elsewhere.”

South Carolina has its own fentanyl-induced homicide law, which took effect in May 2025.

Under the statute, a person who knowingly and unlawfully provides fentanyl or a fentanyl-related substance can face up to 30 years in prison if the drug is found to be the proximate cause of another person’s death.

What would investigators need to prove?

The central questions will be whether drugs caused Panettiere’s death and, if so, who supplied them. Investigators would need evidence connecting a specific person to the substance as well as medical evidence establishing that the drug caused the fatal outcome.

That could depend heavily on autopsy and toxicology results, along with conclusions from a medical examiner or toxicologist. If multiple substances were present, determining exactly what caused the death could become more complicated.

Authorities could also examine text messages, phone calls, electronic devices, surveillance footage and witness accounts. Such evidence may help establish where drugs originated and whether they passed through several people before reaching Panettiere.

The investigation could therefore extend beyond an alleged direct supplier. Prosecutors may examine the broader chain of distribution and the knowledge or actions of everyone involved.

Still, investigators haven’t publicly identified anyone as a suspect, and being present when someone dies doesn’t by itself establish criminal responsibility.

Brian Hickerson, Panettiere’s on-and-off boyfriend, and his brother were reportedly at the residence. Hickerson’s attorney has urged people to allow the investigation to proceed, noting that police have confirmed there were no signs of foul play.

The case remains open for the time being. The official cause of death and toxicology findings could prove critical in determining whether prosecutors have enough evidence to pursue charges.

articles.title: Wladimir Klitschko shares a heartbreaking birthday tribute to his late ex Hayden Panettiere
articles.standfirst: The retired boxer urged fans to choose kindness and love as he remembered the mother of his daughter
articles.summary: The retired boxer urged fans to choose kindness and love as he remembered the mother of his daughter
articles.body:
Wladimir Klitschko has paid a deeply emotional tribute to his late former fiancée Hayden Panettiere on what would have been her 37th birthday.

The actress, known for her roles in Heroes and Nashville, died on August 16 at the age of 36 in South Carolina, just days before her birthday. Authorities have said there was no evidence of foul play, while the official cause and manner of her death remain under investigation.

On Friday, Klitschko shared a photograph of Panettiere on Instagram alongside a heartfelt message reflecting on the birthday they had once expected to celebrate together. The former heavyweight boxing champion chose to honor her life, spirit and the love she brought to those around her.

“Instead of celebrating the way we had planned, today we celebrate her life, her spirit, and the love she brought into this world,” Klitschko wrote.

The 50-year-old also thanked Panettiere's friends, fans and supporters for the messages and kindness shown to his family since her death. He said the overwhelming support had reminded him that compassion and goodness can still be found during even the darkest moments.

“I want to thank all of Hayden’s fans, friends, and everyone who has reached out for the incredible outpouring of love and support,” he wrote.

“At a time filled with so much sadness, your kindness has reminded me that there is still so much good in humanity.”

Klitschko then used the emotional occasion to encourage others to embrace love and kindness in their own lives.

“If you’re reading this, I ask just one thing: Even if only for a moment, think about LOVE. Reach out to a friend. Forgive someone. Be kind,” he wrote. “Love is a superpower. Use it.”

He ended the tribute with a simple but powerful message directly to Panettiere , telling her that she was loved, missed and would never be forgotten.

A lasting bond through their daughter

Klitschko and Panettiere first met in 2009 and began a relationship that would continue, with periods apart, for almost a decade. They split in 2011 before rekindling their romance and becoming engaged in 2013.

Their daughter, Kaya , was born in December 2014. The couple eventually separated again in 2018 but remained connected through their daughter.

Following Panettiere's death, Klitschko previously described his family as being in a period of “profound shock and grief.” He remembered his former partner as an important part of his life and the mother of their daughter, while also celebrating her talent and accomplishments as an actress.

He acknowledged that Panettiere had faced difficult periods while working in a demanding entertainment industry, but stressed that nothing could erase the memories they shared or the important place she held in their family.

Most poignantly, Klitschko promised to ensure that Kaya would remember her mother with respect. He said he'd always speak about Panettiere in a way that honored the person she was.

Despite their complicated relationship history, Panettiere and Klitschko remained permanently connected through their daughter.

articles.title: Jennifer Lopez and Ben Affleck narrowly avoid post-divorce run-in at L.A. office building
articles.standfirst: The former couple were photographed at the same West Hollywood complex, raising the possibility of an unexpected encounter
articles.summary: The former couple were photographed at the same West Hollywood complex, raising the possibility of an unexpected encounter
articles.body:
Jennifer Lopez and Ben Affleck may have come remarkably close to another post-divorce encounter after the former couple were spotted at the same Los Angeles office building on Aug. 20.

According to photos reported by Just Jared, Lopez and Affleck were each seen at the West Hollywood complex that day.

Affleck's purple Cadillac was reportedly already parked nearby when Lopez arrived, meaning his presence may have been immediately apparent to her. However, there’s no evidence that the former spouses actually saw or spoke to one another.

The photographs show separate arrivals and departures rather than a confirmed meeting. The office complex is also large, so while the timing makes a chance encounter possible, it’s equally plausible that the two went about their respective business without crossing paths.

Their latest sighting echoes a familiar pattern

This isn’t the first time Lopez and Affleck have found themselves working from the same Los Angeles building. In September 2024, shortly after Lopez filed for divorce, the singer and actress was photographed arriving at a building where both reportedly maintained offices.

Affleck was later seen leaving the location, again creating speculation about a possible encounter.

Their divorce was finalized in February 2025 after the pair reached a settlement. A Los Angeles Superior Court judge approved the agreement in January, with their single status taking effect on Feb. 21.

Despite ending their marriage, Lopez and Affleck have shown that they can still appear together publicly when their professional and family lives overlap. Their clearest post-divorce reunion came in October 2025, when they posed together at the New York premiere of Kiss of the Spider Woman.

Lopez stars in the film, while Affleck served as an executive producer through Artists Equity, the company he co-founded with Matt Damon.

That appearance was notably different from their latest office-building sighting. Lopez acknowledged Affleck during a red-carpet interview, and the former couple posed together for photographers. Affleck also publicly praised her performance, calling her work in the movie something he was proud to be associated with.

Their connection has also continued through their children. Lopez has remained close with Affleck’s children from his previous marriage to Jennifer Garner , while Affleck has maintained a relationship with Lopez’s twins, whom she shares with Marc Anthony.

The former couple have been spotted attending events involving their children, suggesting that their post-divorce relationship has remained cordial.

Lopez has also spoken more openly about the emotional aftermath of their split. During a 2026 appearance on the SmartLess podcast, she reflected on the period following the divorce and described taking time to step back and figure herself out.

“There comes a point where it’s all so puzzling and wrong. Where you have to sit there. After my last divorce, I just sat there,” Lopez said.

“I canceled my tour and I sat there, and I was like, ‘You need fucking figure yourself out.’”

Given their complicated history, even an accidental near-miss is enough to attract attention.

articles.title: Hayden Panettiere’s final hours: Boyfriend’s brother reveals how she was found unconscious
articles.standfirst: New details emerge as authorities continue investigating the circumstances surrounding the actress’s sudden death
articles.summary: New details emerge as authorities continue investigating the circumstances surrounding the actress’s sudden death
articles.body:
New details have emerged about Hayden Panettiere’ s final moments, days after the actress died at 36 in South Carolina. Zach Hickerson, brother of Panettiere’s on-and-off boyfriend Brian Hickerson , has described what happened after he returned to the Airbnb where the pair had been staying.

Zach said he’d planned to meet Panettiere and Brian for lunch before going indoor golfing. After leaving church, he called and texted them but got no response.

Assuming they were asleep, he drove back to the rental, where he initially couldn’t get inside because he didn’t have the door code.

After knocking loudly, Zach said he woke Brian , who had been napping with Panettiere on a pullout couch. The brothers then discovered the actress was unconscious.

“I knocked loudly which apparently woke Brian up from a nap they were both taking on the pull out couch bed in the living room. When we went in and tried to wake Hayden up for lunch, we realized she was unconscious,” he said.

“I immediately called 911 and Brian gave her Narcan. We then jointly performed CPR while 911 was on speaker until Fire and EMS arrived.”

Paramedics and firefighters later arrived and continued lifesaving efforts, but Panettiere couldn’t be revived. She was pronounced dead at approximately 2:32 p.m.

Investigation continues as tributes pour in

Although reports have pointed to a possible overdose, authorities haven’t officially determined Panettiere’s cause of death.

Her autopsy found no signs of trauma that contributed to her death, while additional studies, including toxicology testing, are still pending. Officials have described the investigation as active and ongoing.

Zach has urged people to avoid speculation and accusations while investigators work to establish what happened. He described Panettiere as one of his closest friends over the past eight years and said he was devastated by her death.

Panettiere’s former fiancé, Wladimir Klitschko , also paid tribute on what would have been her 37th birthday. The former heavyweight champion, who shares daughter Kaya with Panettiere , encouraged people to respond to her death with love, kindness and forgiveness.

The actress had spoken publicly throughout her career about postpartum depression, addiction and recovery. In her 2026 memoir, This Is Me: A Reckoning, she reflected on those struggles and the difficult decision to allow Klitschko full custody of their daughter while she focused on recovery.

Her openness has also renewed scrutiny of her former relationship with Neutrogena. Panettiere previously said the brand ended its partnership with her after she discussed postpartum depression publicly.

Following her death, Neutrogena acknowledged that its handling of the situation made her feel unsupported and pledged a significant investment in women’s health initiatives, including support for postpartum depression.

As tributes continue, Panettiere’s family, friends and fans are left remembering an actress whose career spanned decades, while authorities continue working to determine the circumstances surrounding her sudden death.

articles.title: Leonardo DiCaprio’s latest disguise attempt sparks internet frenzy
articles.standfirst: The unusual exit strategy quickly drew comments from people gathered nearby
articles.summary: The unusual exit strategy quickly drew comments from people gathered nearby
articles.body:
L eonardo DiCaprio has spent decades trying to avoid the spotlight when he’s off the clock, but his latest public appearance has once again proven that hiding from cameras is nearly impossible when you're one of Hollywood’s most recognizable faces.

The Oscar-winning actor recently sparked a wave of online reactions after being spotted leaving a venue in a manner that immediately caught the attention of fans and onlookers. According to videos circulating online, DiCaprio appeared to wait several seconds while a group of women walking ahead of him exited first.

Only after they had moved out of the way did the Titanic star step out himself, with his head lowered despite already wearing a baseball cap and a face mask. The unusual exit strategy quickly drew comments from people gathered nearby. One person in the crowd could be heard shouting, “Always hiding his face, but why?” That question has followed DiCaprio for years.

A long-running habit of pulling baseball caps low over his eyes

The 50-year-old actor has built a reputation for using hats, masks, hoodies, sunglasses, umbrellas, and virtually anything else within reach to shield himself from photographers. His efforts have become so legendary that they are now almost as recognizable as the actor himself.

Publications have documented his long-running habit of pulling baseball caps low over his eyes or covering much of his face during public outings. As footage of the latest sighting spread across social media, users wasted no time turning the moment into comedy.

One X user came to DiCaprio’s defense, writing, “He just doesn't want to be photographed; he's been covering his face for years and paparazzi still show up to photograph him when they know he's not gonna give them anything.” Another commenter took a more humorous approach, joking, “Definitely not Leonardo, that’s a decoy.”

DiCaprio has never hidden the fact that he values privacy

The joke reflects a long-running internet theory that DiCaprio’s disguises have become so extreme that fans sometimes wonder whether the person being photographed is actually the actor at all. Similar comments have surfaced online during previous appearances in which he concealed nearly his entire face behind hats, masks, or other makeshift barriers.

Of course, DiCaprio has never hidden the fact that he values privacy. In past interviews, he has explained that maintaining some distance from constant public exposure has been an important part of sustaining a career that has lasted more than three decades. He has said that when he is not promoting a project, he prefers to “disappear as much as you possibly can.”

Despite those efforts, the actor’s attempts to go unnoticed rarely succeed. Whether he is attending a sporting event, boarding a yacht, walking through an airport, or arriving at a celebrity wedding, photographers almost always manage to identify him. His famous cap-and-mask combination has become so associated with him that it often attracts even more attention than if he simply walked around normally.

articles.title: Dua Lipa surprises fans with a form-fitting black dress one day before her birthday
articles.standfirst: The singer is just hours away from turning 31.
articles.summary: The singer is just hours away from turning 31.
articles.body:
Dua Lipa is only hours away from turning 31 , and before the date that has become a small annual celebration for her followers arrives, the singer decided to share another glimpse into her life on Instagram.

The post appeared on August 21, just one day before her birthday, and quickly drew attention to her latest look.

Dua Lipa turns to black again for a special occasion

The singer posed in a long, form-fitting black dress , a piece that follows her silhouette while combining an elegant look with a much bolder touch.

She completed the outfit with a chunky bracelet and a hairstyle that also deserves attention: Dua wore her hair in a ponytail paired with a braid, allowing the dress to remain the main focus .

The setting, with a pool in the background, gave the photos a relaxed vacation feel that contrasted with the significance of the occasion.

But there is something interesting about this choice: Dua Lipa already knows exactly how to turn her birthday into a fashion moment .

To understand why the new look is attracting so much attention, it is worth going back just one year.

When she turned 30, Dua Lipa welcomed a new decade with a completely different image. On that occasion, she chose a burgundy dress featuring sparkling black lace details, a plunging neckline and an open back .

Her hair was worn down, and the entire look had a much more dramatic aesthetic.

Now, as she approaches 31, the direction appears different. Black makes another appearance, but this time with a cleaner look centered on her silhouette.

The singer does not need to explain the change for it to stand out: her 30th birthday carried the weight of entering a new decade, while 31 arrives with a different energy .

31 arrives after a very different year

And Dua Lipa is not reaching this birthday at the same point in her life as she was 12 months ago.

Over the past year, the singer wrapped up a major chapter with her Radical Optimism Tour and continued expanding her projects beyond the stage. She also took one of the biggest personal steps of her life by marrying Callum Turner .

The couple first had a civil ceremony in London and later celebrated a multi-day wedding in Sicily, turning Dua's summer into a series of moments that seemed straight out of a movie.

Her work with Service95 has also continued to grow, giving the singer an opportunity to explore a side of herself that goes far beyond music.

That is why this birthday arrives after several especially eventful months for her.

articles.title: What is Narcan, the substance found at the scene where Hayden Panettiere died? This is what it’s used for
articles.standfirst: The medication was reportedly administered after Panettiere was found unconscious, but its presence does not by itself establish a cause of death
articles.summary: The medication was reportedly administered after Panettiere was found unconscious, but its presence does not by itself establish a cause of death
articles.body:
The circumstances surrounding Hayden Panettiere ’s death have brought renewed attention to Narcan, a medication that was reportedly present at the South Carolina property where the actress was found unconscious.

Panettiere, known for her roles in Heroes and Nashville, died at 36 after emergency responders were called to a Greenville residence on Sunday.

Her death remains under investigation, and authorities have not announced an official cause. An autopsy reportedly found no signs of trauma, while investigators have continued examining the circumstances surrounding her death.

New information from Brian Hickerson ’s brother, Zach Hickerson, has provided additional detail about what happened before emergency crews arrived.

Zach said Brian administered Narcan after the brothers found Panettiere unconscious.

"Brian gave her Narcan,” Zach said to TMZ. Zach later described the emergency response in greater detail, saying: "I immediately called 911 and Brian gave her Narcan. We then jointly performed CPR while 911 was on speaker until Fire and EMS arrived. At that point we watched as they tried every measure possible to save her life."

His account is significant because TMZ had previously reported that Narcan was found at the property, although it was initially unclear who had administered it or who had received the medication.

What exactly is Narcan and how does it work?

Narcan is a brand name for naloxone, a medication designed to rapidly reverse the effects of an opioid overdose.

Naloxone works by blocking opioid receptors in the brain. During an opioid overdose, drugs such as fentanyl, heroin, oxycodone, hydrocodone or morphine can suppress the body's ability to breathe. Naloxone can temporarily displace those opioids from their receptors, potentially restoring normal breathing.

It is particularly important to understand that Narcan is not an intoxicating drug and is not itself an opioid. The FDA describes naloxone as an emergency treatment that can be administered by people without medical training when an opioid overdose is suspected.

Narcan became much more accessible in the United States after the FDA approved a 4 mg nasal-spray version for over-the-counter use in March 2023. That decision allowed consumers to obtain the medication without a prescription, including through pharmacies and other retail outlets.

The medicine is intended for emergencies. If someone is suspected of overdosing, naloxone should be administered while emergency medical assistance is sought.

Its effects are temporary, meaning a person can become unconscious again after the medication wears off. The FDA says repeat doses may sometimes be necessary.

That point is important in understanding the circumstances reported at Panettiere’s home. The presence or use of Narcan does not, by itself, establish that someone died from an opioid overdose. Only investigators and medical authorities determining the cause of death can establish what happened.

Panettiere had previously spoken publicly about addiction and her struggles with alcohol and substance use. In her 2026 memoir This Is Me, she discussed those experiences alongside other difficult periods in her life.

Her death has now prompted a broader investigation. TMZ has reported that the Drug Enforcement Administration has become involved, while local authorities continue examining the circumstances.

Zach has also pushed back against speculation surrounding Panettiere’s death: "There are a lot of assumptions, speculations and accusations currently swirling. The truth will come out as the authorities complete and release additional details from the investigation. And that is important because the people who loved and adored Hayden deserve the truth."

He added: "Out of respect for her loved ones, the speculation and sensationalism of her death needs to end until the facts can be released from the investigation."

As investigators work to establish what happened, the reported use of Narcan is one piece of a much larger picture. The medication is specifically designed to save lives during suspected opioid overdoses, but its presence at a scene cannot substitute for a medical determination of the cause of death.

For now, Panettiere’s cause of death remains officially unresolved, and authorities are expected to rely on toxicology, medical evidence, witness accounts and other investigative findings before reaching a final conclusion.

articles.title: Former NFL star Kroy Biermann son's arrested on serious charges as legal process begins
articles.standfirst: Authorities launched an investigation following the complaint
articles.summary: Authorities launched an investigation following the complaint
articles.body:
The son of former NFL linebacker Kroy Biermann and former “Real Housewives of Atlanta” star Kim Zolciak is at the center of a developing legal case that has drawn significant public attention. Kroy “KJ” Biermann Jr., 15, was arrested Monday and charged with aggravated sodomy and aggravated sexual battery following allegations stemming from an incident that allegedly occurred in April at a fitness center in Alpharetta, Georgia.

According to court documents filed in Fulton County Juvenile Court, KJ is being held without bond, and a hearing has been scheduled for Sept. 1. The allegations involve a female classmate who told authorities that KJ assaulted her inside a co-ed sauna at a Life Time fitness facility on April 23. According to the court filings, the girl alleged that KJ attempted multiple times to have sexual intercourse with her despite her objections and further accused him of forcing oral sex and digitally penetrating her.

The accuser told investigators that she eventually managed to leave the area and later contacted family members after experiencing a panic attack the following day. She was subsequently examined at North Fulton Hospital in Georgia.

Authorities launched an investigation following the complaint

According to the police report, medical testing conducted after the alleged incident did not find male DNA in the victim’s mouth or vagina. Court records also indicate that while KJ did not scan into the gym on the day in question, investigators reportedly identified him in security camera footage.

Authorities launched an investigation following the complaint. Police reportedly attempted to contact Kroy Biermann in May regarding the matter. The former NFL playe r later spoke with investigators and indicated he would discuss the situation with Zolciak regarding potential communication with their son.

KJ’s attorney, Jason Sheffield, has strongly denied the allegations on behalf of his client. In a statement, Sheffield said KJ is “100% innocent” and claimed he attempted to provide investigators with evidence supporting his client’s innocence, including the results of a polygraph examination. Sheffield also asserted that there was evidence involving prior allegations made by the accuser, though those claims have not been independently verified in court.

Zolciak also issued a statement defending her son and criticizing what she described as premature judgments surrounding the case. She stated that KJ denies the allegations and pointed to the reported lack of DNA evidence and the polygraph examination as factors she believes support his innocence. The reality television personality also urged the public to allow the legal process to unfold before reaching conclusions.

Arrest comes during a turbulent period for the Biermann family

The case has generated widespread attention in part because of KJ’s family background . His father, Kroy Biermann, enjoyed a successful NFL career after being selected by the Atlanta Falcons in the fifth round of the 2008 NFL Draft . Biermann spent most of his professional career with the Falcons and became a well-known figure in Atlanta sports before retiring from football.

KJ himself has been active in youth athletics, particularly football. Earlier this year, Zolciak publicly praised her son’s dedication to the sport in a birthday tribute, highlighting his work ethic, discipline, and commitment to pursuing his athletic goals.

The arrest comes during a turbulent period for the Biermann family, as Zolciak and Biermann have been navigating a highly publicized divorce since 2023. The former couple share four children together, including KJ, while Biermann also adopted Zolciak’s two daughters from a previous relationship.

articles.title: Cause of death Michael Wright: What is the rare neurological disease ‘The Five Heartbeats’ actor battled?
articles.standfirst: The actor died at 70 after heart failure and complications from a rare condition as his wife shared an emotional farewell
articles.summary: The actor died at 70 after heart failure and complications from a rare condition as his wife shared an emotional farewell
articles.body:
Michael Wright, the actor remembered by generations of fans as Eddie King Jr. in “The Five Heartbeats”, was battling a rare degenerative neurological disease before his death at 70.

Wright died Wednesday, August 19, in Los Angeles. His family said he suffered heart failure along with complications from Marchiafava-Bignami disease, providing new details about what the actor had been facing before his death.

His wife, Susan Wright , announced the heartbreaking news Friday evening, remembering the man behind the characters millions had watched on screen.

Michael Wright battled a rare neurological disease

Marchiafava-Bignami disease is an extremely rare neurological disorder that primarily damages the corpus callosum, the bundle of nerve fibers connecting the two sides of the brain. It can cause a wide range of neurological problems, including confusion, difficulty walking, seizures and changes in consciousness.

Wright's family has not publicly disclosed when he was diagnosed or how long he had been living with the disease.

What they have revealed is that his death followed heart failure coupled with complications from the condition , offering a clearer picture of the circumstances surrounding his final days.

For those closest to Wright, however, his illness was only one small part of a much larger life.

“It is with profound sadness and an unimaginable heaviness in my heart that I share the passing of my beloved husband, Michael Wright,” Susan wrote while announcing his death.

She remembered him as a husband, father, grandfather, friend and “extraordinary artist,” while acknowledging how deeply characters from “The Five Heartbeats”, “The Wanderers”, “V”, “The Principal” and “Streamers” had connected him with audiences.

“Michael, your work will live forever, but your love will live even longer in the hearts of those who knew you best,” she wrote in her farewell.

Michael Wright was much more than Eddie King Jr.

For many fans, Wright will forever be Eddie King Jr. , the charismatic and troubled lead singer at the center of Robert Townsend's 1991 musical drama “The Five Heartbeats”.

Eddie was gifted, magnetic and deeply flawed. His struggles with alcohol and drugs eventually pushed him away from the fictional R&B group, giving Wright some of the film's most emotional scenes and helping turn the character into the role most closely associated with his career.

But Wright's work stretched across nearly five decades.

Born April 30, 1956, in New York City, he appeared in more than 50 film and television productions. His movie credits included “The Wanderers”, “Robert Altman's Streamers”, “The Principal and Sugar Hill”, while television audiences knew him from the sci-fi franchise “V” and HBO's prison drama “Oz”, among other projects.

Years later, Wright explained what drove him as an actor in remarkably simple terms. He believed one of the worst things a performer could do was fail to keep an audience interested.

He wanted viewers to look at his characters and wonder what was happening behind their eyes. Eddie King Jr. was perhaps the clearest example of that philosophy.

His family remembers the man audiences couldn't see

Susan's statement also made clear that the Michael Wright remembered by his family was bigger than any role.

She described the loss as “enormous and deeply personal” and thanked fans for the prayers, memories and condolences that began arriving after news of his death spread.

The family said more information about Wright's life, legacy and how they intend to celebrate him will be shared when they are ready.

Wright once said in a 2021 interview that he wouldn't go back and change his life. He had traveled the world, learned multiple languages and experienced what he wanted to experience.

It feels particularly poignant now. Michael Wright spent decades trying to create characters people wouldn't forget.

articles.title: Sydney Sweeney and boyfriend Scooter Braun transform into Wonder Woman and Superman for some very special photos
articles.standfirst: The couple swapped Hollywood glamour for costumes, summer adventures and a playful weekend together
articles.summary: The couple swapped Hollywood glamour for costumes, summer adventures and a playful weekend together
articles.body:
Sydney Sweeney and Scooter Braun gave fans a rare look at their relationship away from Hollywood’s spotlight, trading red carpets and premieres for superhero costumes during a playful summer getaway.

The Euphoria actress shared a collection of photos on Instagram showing herself dressed as Wonder Woman and Braun taking on the role of Superman , creating a lighthearted moment that quickly caught attention online.

“Camp ‘26,” Sweeney wrote alongside the post, which featured several snapshots from what appeared to be a group summer camp experience.

Sweeney ’s Wonder Woman-inspired outfit included the character’s recognizable red and gold color scheme, a corset-style top, blue shorts decorated with white stars, a gold tiara and a nod to the hero’s famous Lasso of Truth.

Braun joined her in a Superman costume inspired by Henry Cavill’s portrayal of the character in films including Man of Steel, Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice and Justice League.

The couple posed together for a mirror selfie before Sweeney ’s carousel moved through other moments from their trip, including outdoor activities, swimming and karaoke. Braun later shared his own photos from the weekend, captioning his post “Camp of Heroes.”

Sydney and Scooter’s romance continues to grow

The superhero-themed photos arrive as Sweeney and Braun ’s relationship has become increasingly public after months of keeping things relatively private.

The pair were first connected in 2025 after crossing paths at Jeff Bezos and Lauren Sanchez Bezos ’ wedding in Venice, Italy. Initial reports described their relationship as casual, with Sweeney reportedly enjoying a new chapter after ending her engagement to former fiance Jonathan Davino .

However, their relationship appeared to become more serious over time. Braun eventually confirmed their romance publicly, while Sweeney later shared photos of the two together on her own social media.

Braun has also been vocal about his admiration for the actress, praising both her personality and character during an appearance on the Second Thought podcast.

“I’ve met an extraordinary woman, kind and generous and smart, and real and down-to-earth,” Braun said.

Sweeney has also shared affectionate messages about Braun , describing him as someone who brings happiness into her life.

“Happiest of birthdays to the man with the biggest heart I know,” she wrote in a birthday tribute. “Thank you for all the living room dances and making me smile again. A good man is rare. A man like you is once in a lifetime.”

Sweeney’s superhero world extends beyond costumes

The Wonder Woman photos also continue Sweeney ’s connection to comic book characters, following her appearance in Marvel’s Madame Web in 2024.

In the movie, Sweeney played Julia Cornwall, a character connected to the Spider-Man universe who is destined to become a version of Spider-Woman. Her name has also frequently appeared in fan speculation surrounding possible future superhero roles.

While those rumors haven't led to another major comic book casting, Sweeney has continued to build one of Hollywood’s fastest-rising careers through projects across film and television.

The latest photos with Braun offered a different side of the actress, showing the couple embracing humor and nostalgia while enjoying a superhero-themed summer escape.

articles.title: Heidi Klum turns up the heat on Instagram and proves her style still has no limits
articles.standfirst: The German model continues to dazzle.
articles.summary: The German model continues to dazzle.
articles.body:
Heidi Klum once again became the center of attention after sharing a new photo on Instagram, making it clear that she still knows how to surprise her followers.

A photo that left little to the imagination

Klum appeared outdoors with her hair down and a colorful blanket as part of her look, while wearing only white underwear and leaving her torso completely exposed . The daring ensemble once again reflected the confidence with which the model has always experimented with her image.

The post was accompanied by a simple good morning message.

Heidi Klum also knows how to completely change her mood

Days later, Klum shared another post from Project Runway, this time with a much more elegant look . Sitting in front of the cameras, she wore a shiny black dress, matching heels and her hair down, creating a sophisticated image that was completely different.

The transformation captures one of the defining characteristics that has followed Klum throughout her career: her ability to move between very different styles and adapt to every setting without losing her essence .

A career that has gone far beyond the runway

For decades, the model has established herself as a true fashion icon, thanks to a career shaped by choices that have gone far beyond the trends of the moment.

Klum rose to international fame during the 1990s and became one of the best-known faces of Victoria's Secret . She also appeared on the cover of Sports Illustrated Swimsuit, while building a career that would eventually expand into other areas of entertainment.

Television became an important part of that journey. Project Runway is one of her most notable projects, while Germany's Next Topmodel has allowed her to maintain a constant presence in front of audiences in her home country.

articles.title: BigXthaPlug is arrested ahead of two major concerts as his weekend takes an unexpected turn
articles.standfirst: What happened?
articles.summary: What happened?
articles.body:
BigXthaPlug had a weekend of music and performances ahead of him , with two major shows scheduled within just 24 hours. However, on Friday, August 21 , when he was expected to take the stage at the Country Rising Festival in Winnipeg, Canada , the festival announced that he would not perform.

What was initially described by the festival as a “personal emergency” eventually received a more concrete explanation: Xavier Landum had been arrested that same day by the Allen Police Department and taken to the Collin County Jail in Texas.

Why was BigXthaPlug arrested?

According to records, Landum was arrested on three charges: driving while intoxicated, possession of less than two ounces of marijuana, and unlawful possession of a firearm.

BigXthaPlug regains his freedom

After the uncertainty surrounding his arrest, first over how long he would remain in custody and then over whether he would be able to make his next scheduled appearance, BigXthaPlug was released from jail on bond Saturday morning. Shortly afterward, he confirmed through his social media accounts that he was free .
